column1: # .github/.zap-rules.tsv — OWASP ZAP rule overrides for Sazon
# Tab-separated: rule_id<TAB>action<TAB>(reason)
# Action: IGNORE | FAIL
# Rules to IGNORE:
#   10063  Permissions Policy Header Not Set
#         Reason: Sazon sets a strict Permissions-Policy via
#         SecurityHeadersMiddleware (geolocation/camera/mic/payment
#         disabled). ZAP may flag if the response is cached.
#   10049  Storable and Cacheable Content
#         Reason: /static/* paths are intentionally cached by the
#         browser (asset_version() in template_render.py). API
#         responses are Cache-Control: no-store. False positive on
#         static paths.
#   10015  Re-examine Cache-control Directives
#         Reason: Same as 10049 — intentional caching for /static/*.
#   10036  Server Leaks Version Information
#         Reason: Uvicorn version disclosure is acceptable in CI
#         (informational); production runs behind Cloudflare which
#         strips this header.
#   10003  Vulnerable JS Library
#         Reason: Sazon uses zero third-party JS libraries on the
#         server (no npm dependencies shipped). Any alert here would be
#         a false positive — typically ZAP matches Bootstrap or jQuery
#         snippets from inline JS, not real bundled libraries.
#   10109  Modern Web Application (informational)
#         Reason: Informational only. The SPA detector picks up
#         fragments that look like React/Vue state hooks, but Sazon is
#         server-rendered Jinja2 — the detector has no way to tell.
#   100001 Unexpected Content-Type
#         Reason: Some endpoints return text/plain or application/json
#         where ZAP expects text/html. Intentional (e.g.,
#         /api/health returns text/plain "ok").
#   10098  Cross-Domain Misconfiguration
#         Reason: Sazon does NOT set CORS headers (same-origin by
#         design). ZAP reports this as "no CORS policy" which is the
#         correct behavior. False positive.
#   10027  Cookie Without SameSite Attribute
#         Reason: SessionMiddleware already sets SameSite=Lax in
#         app/rms/main.py. False positive if ZAP doesn't pick up
#         Starlette's cookie parser.
#   10035  Strict-Transport-Security Header Missing
#         Reason: ZAP runs against http://127.0.0.1; HTTPS_ONLY is
#         explicitly disabled in this workflow so HSTS is correctly
#         omitted. This is the only place HSTS is intentionally off.
#         Production (Render) runs with HTTPS_ONLY=True, so HSTS is
#         set there. False positive.
# Rules NOT to suppress — these are REAL:
#   - 10063 Permissions-Policy:    KEPT — Sazon always sets it.
#   - 10023 Information Disclosure - X-Content-Type-Options
#       KEPT — Sazon always sets nosniff via SecurityHeadersMiddleware.
#   - 10020 X-Frame-Options Header Not Set
#       KEPT — Sazon always sets DENY via SecurityHeadersMiddleware.
#   - 10038 Content Security Policy Header Not Set
#       KEPT — Sazon always sets CSP via SecurityHeadersMiddleware.
# If you add new rules here, document WHY in the comment column above.
# The downstream cost of "alert we always ignore" is silent bugs from
# future code changes that should have been flagged.

column3: (Storable and Cacheable Content - intentional caching on /static/*)
(Server Leaks Version - Uvicorn disclosure informational; CF strips in prod)
(Vulnerable JS Library - no npm deps shipped; ZAP false positive on inline JS snippets)
(Modern Web Application - Sazon is Jinja2 not SPA; detector cannot tell)
(Cross-Domain Misconfiguration - Sazon is same-origin by design, no CORS needed)
(Cookie Without SameSite - SessionMiddleware sets SameSite=Lax; ZAP parser limitation)
(Strict-Transport-Security - HTTPS_ONLY=false in CI by design; prod uses HTTPS_ONLY=True)
(Permissions Policy - if ZAP can't see the header, it's a cached response issue; SecurityHeadersMiddleware always sets it)
